integrity: Every profile and perfect matching through the claimed boundary is exhausted. Stability, rank-maximality, and egalitarian optimality are each cross-checked by independent exact implementations.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for complete strict stable-marriage instances through three agents per side. An earlier July 1985 manuscript is bibliographically attested but lacked a verified exact public day in the inspected sources.
title: Sharp three-by-three conflict layer for rank-maximal and egalitarian stable marriage
